review.tagline: Chinese-language course on LLM theory and building a LLaMA2-style model
review.summary: Happy-LLM is a Datawhale course in eight chapters, written in Chinese with an English README. It covers NLP basics, the Transformer and pretrained model families, then implements LLaMA2 in PyTorch, trains a tokenizer, and runs pretraining, SFT, LoRA/QLoRA, RAG, agents and GRPO-based agentic RL. Two 215M checkpoints from chapter 5 are published on ModelScope.
review.audience: Students and engineers learning how LLMs are built and trained, reading Chinese
strengths: Covers Transformer basics through pretraining, SFT, LoRA/QLoRA, RAG, agents and agentic RL
Publishes 215M base and SFT checkpoints plus a ModelScope studio to try them
Free PDF and companion slides available from the releases page
Dependencies split per chapter, with an environment preparation guide
weaknesses: Main content is in Chinese; only the README has an English version
Content license is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, which restricts commercial use
Hardware requirements are not stated in the README, only in a separate doc
Extra Chapter blog section is marked as in progress
